integrity: Exact, deterministic complete finite enumeration with distinct row-reduction/reachability and subgroup-lattice inclusion-exclusion implementations; not a formal or independently audited result.
scientific_limitations: The counts concern only four-dimensional simple perfect evolution algebras over F_2. The historical total of 908 unrestricted perfect classes is not new; 2026 survey full-text access was incomplete; historical priority is not independently established.
title: The complete symmetry census of simple four-dimensional binary evolution algebras
